ui.victoryScreen:
VICTORY!

You defeated the dungeon boss and survived the depths.
ui.defeatScreen:
THE ENTIRE PARTY HAS FALLEN.

The dungeon swallows up another expedition...
ui.endingCheckpointPrompt: The floor changes here, though none of you could say how. What comes next is not like any room before it.
ui.endingLeaveOnlyPrompt: There is no staying here and no going further. Only the way back up is offered.
ui.endingLeaveOnlyOption: [1] Turn back. There's nowhere else to go from here.
ui.endingStayOption: [1] Stay — and be part of what holds this floor together.
ui.endingLetGoOption: [2] Let go, together, all at once — however far down that actually leads.
ui.endingContinueOption: [3] Keep going, past the point where any of you can call this a choice.
ui.endingStayScreen:
THE PARTY STAYS.

The way back up is where it always was. No one climbs it. Packs come off and are left on the stone; the torch burns down to a height it does not drop below again. Much later, another party comes down this corridor. They do not know your names. Something in how they move through it is easier than it should be.
ui.endingLetGoScreen:
THE PARTY LETS GO.

None of you feel yourselves stop. It comes gradually: the awareness that whatever is dreaming does not tell you apart from everything else it holds. The last clear thought any of you has, before the difference stops mattering, is of the sky above the entrance, the town you set out from, the years before any of this. None of it was ever outside. It was a farther room of the same dream, dreamed calmly enough that no one standing in it needed to notice.
ui.endingLeaveAmbushedScreen:
AN UNKNOWN FATE.

The corridor you climbed through isn't here anymore. Where it should be, there's only wall — smooth, seamless, older than anything else on this floor. However you got down here, that's not how you're getting back up.

There has to be another way. There's always been another way. You start looking — and that's when you hear how many of them have been standing behind you the whole time you were looking at the wall instead.

Someone gets half a word out. Nobody gets a clean look at how many there are.
ui.founderDialogue:
A vast, wrong shape drifts in the dark ahead of you — more brain than body, ropes of nerve-thick tissue trailing beneath it where legs should be, reaching without ever quite touching the ground. It has no face left to speak from. Something in the room remembers how his voice sounded anyway.

"You made it further than any of them."
"I didn't come down here to build anything. I came down because everyone I was supposed to save was already gone, and I couldn't stop asking the ground to give them back."
"It never gave anyone back. It just... kept listening. So I kept asking. Eventually I stopped noticing I was still asking."

He is closer than he was. None of you saw him cross the distance.

"The others who followed me down, over the years — I taught them how to ask properly. That's all any of it ever was."
"I don't remember the last time I was only a person. I'm not sure there's a difference anymore, between what's still me and what's still just... dreaming."

Somewhere behind the walls, something takes a breath the room is too small to hold.

"You could have turned back, once. Now you can keep asking, the way I did, until there's nothing left to tell you apart from what you asked for."
ui.gatekeeperPaid: He doesn't count them. 'Then hear this. What's down there wants what you want, and it can wait longer than you can. The first thing that shines, leave it where it lies.' He presses two fingers to each of your brows and says something under his breath, in no tongue you know. 'That will follow you a little way. Not to the bottom.'
ui.gatekeeperBlessing: Blessed: {{stats}} for the next {{rooms}} rooms (rest rooms don't count).
ui.gatekeeperRefused: He laughs once, short, and steps aside from the cave mouth. 'Good luck, then.'
ui.endingLeaveEscapedScreen:
ESCAPED.

The corridor you climbed through isn't here anymore. Where it should be, there's only wall — smooth, seamless, older than anything else on this floor. However you got down here, that's not how you're getting back up.

A seam answers from further along the same dead-end wall, sealed shut, humming at a pitch none of you would have caught if you weren't already listening for anything. It isn't stone. It has been failing for longer than any of you have been alive.

The shard fits. The seam opens as if it remembered how. On the other side is air: ordinary, undeserved air.

runner.notice0: The hood is the Merchant's, cut smaller. His pack is already open on the floor, every item with its mark turned toward you. "Late," he says, and bows exactly the way the Merchant bows.
runner.notice1: A hooded figure is warming his hands at the fire, though the fire gives off no heat you can feel. His pack sits unstrapped beside him. "You took the long way," he says. "Sit, if you like. I haven't touched anything."
runner.notice2: He is already standing when you reach the fire, as though he heard you three rooms back. A spiral is burned into his pack strap. "Same shop," he says.

ui.campReflectionTier1Prompt: Someone's checking their supplies again before sleep, same as every night. Tonight it takes slightly less time than it used to. It's just faster now, knowing which pouch to reach for first.
ui.campReflectionTier1Option1: It's not worth thinking about. Whatever gets it done fastest is fine.
ui.campReflectionTier1Option2: Someone should be keeping count. Just in case it starts to matter later.
ui.campReflectionTier1Option3: Somewhere back there, reaching for it stopped feeling like deciding to.
ui.campReflectionTier2Prompt: The whole day's route got picked around which rooms were worth the detour — not for the treasure, for the trade. Three floors ago it would have seemed a strange way to spend a day. Whoever suggested it first, none of you can quite say.
ui.campReflectionTier2Option1: It's efficient. That's all that needs to be true about it.
ui.campReflectionTier2Option2: Getting good at something like this isn't the same as it being safe.
ui.campReflectionTier2Option3: You almost admire how naturally it's become part of the plan.
ui.campReflectionTier3Prompt: Nobody argued about it this time. Whoever was closest just did it, the way you'd catch a falling cup without thinking, and the rest of you kept eating like nothing happened. Someone almost said something, and didn't.
ui.campReflectionTier3Option1: Someone should have said something. Nobody wanted to be the first.
ui.campReflectionTier3Option2: There wasn't anything to say. It's just what the party does now.
ui.campReflectionTier3Option3: You keep waiting for it to feel like a choice again. It hasn't, in a while.
ui.campReflectionTier4Prompt: Nobody mentions it anymore, at camp or anywhere else. It isn't that it stopped mattering — it stopped being a separate thing from everything else you do to get through a day. Someone asks what's for dinner. Someone else answers with their mouth full. The rest of it just happened somewhere in between, the way breathing happens.
ui.campReflectionTier4Option1: Nobody outside would follow it anyway.
ui.campReflectionTier4Option2: Explaining it wouldn't change anything now.
ui.campReflectionTier4Option3: Nobody's asked in a long time. Nobody will.
